macros.name: AbbreviateFirstname
macros.doc: This turns first names into initials, e.g. John into J. and Jean-Luc into J.-L.

macros.name: Cite
macros.doc: This adds <entry key> to <list> (if the latter doesn't exist, it is created on the fly), unless it has already been added previously.

macros.name: EntryNumberFor
macros.doc: This returns n if <entry key> is the nth entry in <list>, i.e. if it is the nth entry to be cited for the first time in <list>.

macros.name: ifequalentry
macros.doc: For each entry you can use the \ifequalentry conditional, which is true if the current entry is part of a set of entries that are equal with regard to \SortingOrder and are thus distinguished by citation order only, and false otherwise.

macros.name: Preamble
macros.doc: This holds everything that has been encountered in @preamble entries when reading bibliographies.

macros.name: RetrieveFieldFor
macros.doc: This produces the value of <field> for <entry key>.

macros.name: RetrieveFieldInFor
macros.doc: This one defines <command> as the value of <field> for <entry key>.

macros.name: SortDef
macros.doc: This defines <command> as <definition> at sorting time.

macros.name: SortingOrder
macros.doc: This sets the order in which lists will be sorted.

macros.name: SortList
macros.doc: This sorts <list> according to the latest value of \SortingOrder.

macros.name: TypesetFieldFor
macros.doc: If <field> isn't empty in <entry key>, <command> is executed with the value of <field> as its argument.
